answers.core: Again, the builtin create dialog isn't customizable enough, and it's related to fundamental properties of classes, which would be useful to have in core.
answers.workaround: The built-in class name picker is tied in the editor to use the `CreateDialog`, which itself also doesn't have this feature. Implementing this in user code would require implementing a new create dialog from scratch.

title: Allow `PROPERTY_HINT_TYPE_STRING` properties to accept abstract classes in the dialog
